building: Morgan J. Burke Boilermaker Aquatic Center
scope: Only the Aquatic Center asset and audit/batchC_boilermaker_aquatic_r1 were changed. No master, README, manifest, or shared indexes were edited. No commit.
r3_findings_addressed: Facade still uniform, brick relief imperceptible.
Seating and interior circulation looked schematic.

source_review.source: Google Street View north approach panorama TdL92OGnlFSS8CxGuVLKDA, July 2023
source_review.supports: Qualitative brick facade, long ribbon/clerestory band, north entry canopy, and direct-mounted building lettering. It is not calibrated and provides no measured proportions.
Published aquatic program, dive-pool depth and platform levels, and spectator capacity.
Mezzanine and program spaces, but not a dimensioned seating/interior plan.
Horizontal footprint correspondence only; not vertical survey control or master registration.

changes: Replaced the prior front-face brick texture coordinate mapping with a real-scale projection for vertical wall surfaces, so the running-bond courses and mortar relief read across the full perimeter shell. The close facade render shows the masonry pattern; it does not prove exact brick size or wall material specification.
Raised the estimated roof standing-seam relief from a very fine line to visible, soft silver-gray seams on both roof slopes. Roof form and dimensions remain unverified.

Reduced direct-mounted lettering width from the prior oversized treatment to approximately 4.65 model units, centered over the entry. This is a visual estimate from the qualitative Street View image, not a measured dimension.

Cut a schematic central access aisle into the spectator bank and split the concrete tiers around it; added 12 stair treads and handrails. Reduced representative count from 300 to 288. This responds to the need for readable circulation but is not claimed to match an as-built arrangement.
Added small bevels to seat pan/back edges and a dedicated pool-side seating-aisle camera to make the stand legible.
validation: Fresh reopen in Blender 5.2.3 passed. All 70 official FID 896 GIS boundary edges correspond bidirectionally with all 70 shell perimeter segments, max sampled error 0.000002m in each direction; this is footprint correspondence only, not survey or master-placement validation. Validation confirms 57 ribbon panes, 70 mapped vertical masonry faces, 4.651m visually estimated lettering width, 86 roof-seam splines, 288 representative seats, 12 aisle treads, 24 split step sections, mezzanine/stairs, published dive-pool depth/platforms, materials on all meshes, and no external image dependencies.
uncertainties: No calibrated facade elevation or roof section located; roof profile, heights, facade bay proportions, masonry course size, and sign scale remain estimates.
No as-built interior plan located; seating arrangement, center aisle, mezzanine arrangement, and circulation remain schematic.
GIS does not prove vertical dimensions or placement within the master.
